newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia will impose new aviation rules this year.
newsitem.headline: Russia will impose new aviation rules this year.

text.p: Russia's aviation authorities said on Wednesday they planned to introduce new federal aviation rules by the end of this year.
Yury Karetsky, head of the pilots' department of the Federal Aviation Service, said the rules would include new standards of air safety for all Russian air carriers.
"We want to move closer to the international air regulation system," Karetsky told Reuters.
He said the rules would be presented for consideration by experts of the International Air Transport Association (IATA).
"Later they will be approved by the Russian government," he added.
Karetsky said 390 airlines were currently registered in Russia.
"We hope that the number of carriers will be reduced by 150 over the next two years because many are in a bad financial position," he said.
